from solution import first_even
import inspect


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: first_even([1, 3, 5, 7, 4, 1, 6, 8]) == 4."""
    assert first_even([1, 3, 5, 7, 4, 1, 6, 8]) == 4  # 1%2==1, 3%2==1, 5%2==1, 7%2==1, 4%2==0 -> 4


def test_issue_returns_value_not_index():
    """Find the first even number, so return the value 2 not its index 1."""
    assert first_even([1, 2, 3]) == 2  # 1%2==1, 2%2==0 -> 2 (index would be 1, 1+1=2)


def test_issue_returns_first_not_last():
    """Find the first even number in a given list, so return 2 not 6."""
    assert first_even([2, 4, 6]) == 2  # 2%2==0 first -> 2, last would be 6 (2+4=6)


def test_issue_returns_first_not_smallest():
    """Find the first even number, so return 8 not the smallest even 2."""
    assert first_even([8, 2, 4]) == 8  # 8%2==0 first -> 8, minimum would be 2 (2+6=8)


def test_issue_only_last_is_even():
    """Find the first even number when only the last element is even."""
    assert first_even([1, 3, 5, 8]) == 8  # 1%2==1, 3%2==1, 5%2==1, 8%2==0 -> 8


def test_issue_zero_is_even():
    """Find the first even number, and zero counts as even."""
    assert first_even([1, 3, 0, 2]) == 0  # 1%2==1, 3%2==1, 0%2==0 -> 0 (0+0=0)


def test_issue_negative_even_first():
    """Find the first even number among negative numbers."""
    assert first_even([-5, -3, -8, 4]) == -8  # -5%2==1, -3%2==1, -8%2==0 -> -8


def test_issue_single_even_element():
    """Find the first even number in a single-element list."""
    assert first_even([4]) == 4  # 4%2==0 -> 4 (2+2=4)


def test_issue_large_numbers():
    """Find the first even number with large values."""
    assert first_even([999999937, 1000000000, 2]) == 1000000000  # 999999937%2==1, 1000000000%2==0 -> 1000000000


def test_contract_result_is_element_of_input():
    """Find the first even number in a given list, so result must be an element of the input."""
    assert first_even([5, 7, 12, 14]) == 12  # 5%2==1, 7%2==1, 12%2==0 -> 12 (12 in list)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface: def first_even(nums) takes one argument."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(first_even).parameters) == 1  # 0+1=1 parameter 'nums' -> 1
